2607.11388.title: StructAgent: Harness Long-horizon Digital Agents with Unified Causal Structure
2607.11388.paper_summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) have enabled increasingly capable digital agents for computer use. However, real-world tasks are often long-horizon and involve evolving contexts containing accumulated observations, intermediate edits, failed attempts, and partially completed executions. Existing agents typically operate over raw interaction history, making task progress difficult to interpret, verify, and recover, which ultimately limits reliable long-horizon execution. In this paper, we argue that addressing this challenge requires explicitly structuring both the agent's state and workflow around a unified causal representation of task progress. We present \textbf{StructAgent}, a state-centered framework that introduces a unified state for maintaining compact, verifiable task progress and a structured workflow that regulates progress through verifier-backed state transitions. Building on this design, StructAgent further enables explicit progress checkpointing, evidence-driven task completion, targeted failure recovery, and tool-supported execution, while ensuring that all progress updates remain grounded in verification. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StructAgent consistently improves a wide range of LLM and VLM backbones on long-horizon computer-use tasks. On OSWorld-Verified, it improves Qwen3.5-9B from 27.0\% to 46.9\% success rate and Qwen3.5-27B from 31.6\% to 62.2\%, while achieving a new open-source state of the art of 78.9\% with MiniMax-M3. Moreover, the same framework generalizes beyond desktop environments to Minecraft, demonstrating the generality of our design.
2607.11388.paper_summary_zh: 最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）和視覺-語言模型（VLMs）方面的進展，使得數位代理在電腦使用上變得越來越有能力。<lb/>然而，現實世界的任務通常是長期的，並涉及包含累積觀察、中間編輯、失敗嘗試和部分完成執行的演變上下文。<lb/>現有的代理通常在原始互動歷史上運作，這使得任務進展難以解釋、驗證和恢復，最終限制了可靠的長期執行。<lb/>在本文中，我們主張，解決這一挑戰需要明確地圍繞任務進展的統一因果表示來結構化代理的狀態和工作流程。<lb/>我們提出了\textbf{StructAgent}，這是一個以狀態為中心的框架，介紹了一個統一的狀態，用於維持緊湊、可驗證的任務進展，以及一個結構化的工作流程，通過驗證者支持的狀態轉換來調節進展。<lb/>基於這一設計，StructAgent進一步實現了明確的進展檢查點、基於證據的任務完成、針對性的失敗恢復和工具支持的執行，同時確保所有進展更新都保持在驗證的基礎上。<lb/>大量實驗表明，StructAgent在長期電腦使用任務上，持續改善了廣泛的LLM和VLM骨幹。在OSWorld-Verified上，它將Qwen3.5-9B的成功率從27.0\%提高到46.9\%，將Qwen3.5-27B的成功率從31.6\%提高到62.2\%，同時以MiniMax-M3達到新的開源最先進水平78.9\%。<lb/>此外，這一框架還超越了桌面環境，推廣到Minecraft，展示了我們設計的通用性。
